//: Copy to %ProgramData%\PanRaProxy\appsettings.json and adapt. Settings here override the defaults in the install folder. Secrets never go in this file: set them from an elevated prompt with PanRaProxy --set-secret radius and PanRaProxy --set-secret firewall-api-key.

Radius.//: Every RADIUS Client shares the one RADIUS secret.

UserId.//: TimeoutMinutes must be at least twice InterimIntervalMinutes, the interval the NAS sends Interim-Updates at.

Domain.//: Rules are tried in order and the first match decides; a username no rule matches is passed through. Nt4Domain is shorthand for Replace = 'DOMAIN\${user}' and needs a 'user' group in Match. Lookup asks the directory (Windows, domain-joined) and wins when it succeeds, falling back to the same rule's Nt4Domain or Replace.

UsernameRewrites.//: Escape hatch, applied before the domain rules.
